title: You can sleep in this house

slides.text: 8 PEOPLE DIED IN THIS HOUSE. YOU CAN SLEEP IN IT.
June 9, 1912. Villisca, Iowa. The Moore family walks home from a church program with two young guests.
Josiah and Sara Moore, their four children, and two sisters staying the night: Lena and Ina Stillinger, ages 12 and 8.
The next morning, the house was silent. A neighbor noticed no one had come out to do the chores.
All eight had been killed in their sleep. The killer was never caught.
Suspects came and went. One man was tried twice: a hung jury, then an acquittal.
More than 110 years later, it's still one of America's most infamous unsolved crimes.
The house still stands at 508 E. 2nd Street. Restored to how it looked in 1912.
It's open for tours... and you can stay the night. Visitors report footsteps and children's voices.
